events.comment:
================================================================================
SYSTEM: INVENTORY SYSTEM (SPRINT 3.4.5 — TRANSACTION & EVENT CHAIN DECOUPLING)
AUTHOR: Antigravity | LAST MODIFIED: 2026-07-16
PURPOSE: Quản lý giao dịch thêm/bớt vật phẩm vào inventory_state.json. Lắng nghe
InventoryRemoveRequest, InventoryAddRequest, và FlowerHarvested. Phát tín hiệu InventoryUpdated.
================================================================================
BLOCK 1: INVENTORY REMOVE TRANSACTION (e.g., Planting seed)

actions.comment: Verify item exists in inventory_state.json with quantity >= request quantity -> Deduct quantity -> Emit InventoryUpdated & MarkSaveDirty

events.comment: BLOCK 2: INVENTORY ADD TRANSACTION (e.g., FlowerHarvested / Shop Buy)

actions.comment: If FlowerHarvested, add item_harvest_white_lily (+yield). If InventoryAddRequest, add payload item -> Emit InventoryUpdated & MarkSaveDirty
